resources.string: Send a search query to Grok, Claude, ChatGPT and others. Off by default
Shows an Ask chip in search. Telos never stores an API key; the agent app or website uses the account you already signed in with
Auto opens the agent app if it is installed, otherwise the website. Termux runs the matching CLI in the official Termux app
A query of three or more words is sent to the agent instead of opening the top app
Voice input on the search bar
Microphone button uses on-device speech recognition when the phone supports it
Super+Space or Super+A opens search, Super+Enter opens Terminal, Super+1 goes home
Draws thin strips on the screen edges. Swipe in from a side for Back, swipe up from the bottom for Home, tap and hold the bottom strip for Recents. Needs the accessibility service. Off by default
Shows a Telos list of recent apps instead of the system Recents. Off by default
